description: List all users in the PagerDuty account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'users' list of user objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all services in the PagerDuty account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'services' list of service objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single service by its id.

service_id.description: The unique id of the service.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the service object; on failure (service not found), output contains an error message.

description: List incidents, optionally filtered by statuses, service, and urgency; sorted by created_at descending.

statuses.description: Optional list of status strings to filter incidents by (triggered, acknowledged, resolved).

service_id.description: Optional service id to filter incidents by.

urgency.description: Optional urgency to filter incidents by (e.g. high, low).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'incidents' list and a 'total' count; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single incident by its id.

incident_id.description: The unique id of the incident.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the incident object; on failure (incident not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new incident on a service, optionally assigned to a user.

service_id.description: The id of the service the incident belongs to.

assigned_to.description: Optional user id to assign the incident to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created incident object; on failure (service or user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the status and/or assignee of an existing incident.

incident_id.description: The unique id of the incident to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated incident object; on failure (incident/user not found or invalid status), output contains an error message.

description: List the notes attached to an incident.

incident_id.description: The unique id of the incident.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'notes' list; on failure (incident not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a note on an incident.

incident_id.description: The unique id of the incident the note belongs to.

content.description: The text content of the note.

user_id.description: Optional user id of the note author.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created note object; on failure (incident not found), output contains an error message.

description: List current on-call entries derived from schedules, optionally filtered by escalation policy.

escalation_policy_id.description: Optional escalation policy id to filter on-call entries by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'oncalls' list; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'schedules' list; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'escalation_policies' list; on failure, output contains an error message.
